children: Chairman and CEO Jamie Dimon is expected to attend a state dinner President Donald Trump is hosting for Chinese leader Xi Jinping next week, according to a media report on Friday.

The head of the U.S.'s largest bank by assets will join other prominent executives, including Nvidia's Jensen Huang and OpenAI's Sam Altman, at the dinner in Washington on Thursday, Sept. 24, CNBC reported, citing a source familiar with the matter.

The Wall Street bank has been operating in China for over a hundred years. It opened its first branch in China in 1921. In 2020, J.P. Morgan received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to increase its stake in J.P. Morgan Futures Company Limited to 100%. Its J.P. Morgan Securities (China) Company Limited, the company's majority-owned securities company, started operations in March 2020.

title: JPMorgan chief Jamie Dimon set to attend Trump's state dinner for China's Xi - report
